doc.name: DeepDNA
doc.instructions: DeepDNA (https://deepdna.ai): cited, curated knowledge about genes, variants (by rsID) and drug–gene pairs (CPIC or DPWG guidance where a guideline exists) for the genes listed by list_genes. Quote the sources it returns. check_medications screens a medication list for drugs with curated drug–gene records. Never send a genotype or a DNA file: the tools take gene symbols, rsIDs and drug names only, any other argument is refused and not used. Never type a personal genetic result into an argument. DeepDNA never assigns a person a phenotype, metabolizer status, risk or dose. A drug–gene record states what its source (a guideline, a drug label or, where no guideline makes a genotype-based recommendation and no label applies, a study) says for the phenotype groups or genotypes it covers, dose adjustments included; a study-based record reports a research finding, not a recommendation. Present it as that source's statement and do not suggest starting, stopping, switching or changing the dose of anyone's medication; that decision stays with the prescriber. Educational information only, not medical advice. It does not read DNA files.

tools.name: list_genes
tools.title: List genes
tools.description: List the genes in the DeepDNA knowledge base, with a one-line summary and category for each.

tools.name: lookup_gene
tools.title: Look up a gene
tools.description: Everything curated about one gene: function, key variants with rsIDs, metabolizer or function phenotypes, drug interactions, what a consumer genotyping array can and cannot tell you, and sources.

symbol.description: HGNC gene symbol, e.g. CYP2C19. Case-insensitive.

tools.name: lookup_variant
tools.title: Look up a variant
tools.description: One variant by dbSNP rsID: gene, star-allele or common name, alleles, functional effect, population frequency and sources. Send the rsID only, never the user's genotype. A single variant is not a phenotype or metabolizer status.

tools.name: lookup_drug_gene
tools.title: Look up drug–gene guidance
tools.description: Pharmacogenomic guidance for a gene, optionally for one drug: guideline (CPIC or DPWG, "drug label", or null when the record rests on the primary literature), summary of the recommendation, phenotypes and sources. Omit drug to list every drug curated for that gene.

drug.description: Generic drug name, e.g. clopidogrel. Optional.

tools.name: check_medications
tools.title: Screen a medication list
tools.description: Given a list of generic drug names, say which ones have a curated drug–gene record, with which genes and what each record rests on (a CPIC or DPWG guideline, a drug label, or the primary literature), and which are not covered. Needs no genotype.

prompts.name: medication_review
prompts.title: Pharmacogenomic medication review
prompts.description: Check a list of medicines for curated drug–gene guidance and explain it with sources.

prompts.name: explain_variant
prompts.title: Explain a variant
prompts.description: Explain what is known about one variant in plain language, with sources.
